title: Inflection points and transitions in Alzheimer's disease.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: not open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no accessions in text or text-mined, no NCBI links to GEO/SRA/BioProject, no Zenodo/Dryad hits on the DOI. Europe PMC core record lists the publication type as 'Review, Journal Article'.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: it proposes a conceptual framework (disease phases separated by biological thresholds, or 'inflection points') and reports no new measurements or dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: No dataset exists. The paper is a review or perspective (Europe PMC pubType 'Review'), with no supplement, accessions or repository deposits found.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table, so no label column; not checkable.

a5_enough_rows.note: No data; row count does not apply.

honest_claim_h3: No claim possible: the paper offers a conceptual framework without data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use brain tissue measurements of amyloid and tau to predict which disease phase a brain region has reached.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need regional amyloid, phosphorylated-tau and cell-state measurements per brain region; this paper provides none, so the number of examples is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Discrete disease phase (amyloid-dominated versus tau-stress state) per tissue region; the paper defines these phases only conceptually, with no measured labels.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Testing whether Alzheimer's progresses through sharp thresholds rather than a smooth cascade would matter to staging and trial timing, but it needs an external dataset.

ml_idea: None from this paper. The threshold or phase idea could be tested on public Alzheimer's cohort data (e.g. spatial or single-nucleus atlases), but that would be a different project with different data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; there is no dataset.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Europe PMC publication type = Review, with no data links. Already done; it kills the project.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: this is a Nature review or perspective that proposes a conceptual framework for Alzheimer's progression and deposits no data. No supplement, accessions or repository records were found.
